headline: Pakistan urges all sides to uphold commitments under Islamabad MoU
summary: Pakistan urged all sides to uphold the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding, hours after Trump said the interim deal reached with Iran last month was over.
why: US and Iran diplomacy affects Middle East security and oil supply expectations, which are key drivers of global energy prices.

source.name: AL-MONITOR: The Middle Eastʼs leading independent news source since 2012
